caseName: Colonial Beach Co. v. Quemahoning Coal Co.
caseNameFull: Colonial Beach Company, Owner and of the Steamer St. Johns v. Quemahoning Coal Company
attorneys: Mr. Hugh H. Obear, with whom Mr. Paul Du-laney was on the brief, for petitioner. Mr. Richard E. Preece and Mr. John Vance Hewitt, for respondents.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Reversed with costs, and cause remanded to the District Court of the United States for the Eastern District of Virginia United States v. Carver, ante, 482; Piedmont & Georges Creek Coal Co. v. Seaboard Fisheries Co., 254 U. S. 1.
